title: Producer-reported completed acoustic duality and optimal16 support under positive definite covariance
statement: The delivered producer proof reports that for any actual periodic zero-mean G with finite fourth moment and positive definite covariance S, beta=min_mu ell^T W_bar(mu)^+ell/2 is attained over all positive completed rank-one allocations of S. The minimum energy over globally ROC polynomials with leading F_star equals f-beta, also attained. A global dual-contact argument retains9 covariance plus8 signal coordinates with one contact relation, giving at most16 field-dependent completed directions; when the quotient multiplier vanishes, at most4 ordinary directions suffice. Acoustic limit atoms may be necessary at a boundary. This is not a fixed universal catalogue, all-fields success, efficient optimization, independently reviewed proof or full-face QC result. The final completed proof states the fieldwise alternative: a completed covariance certificate exists iff every globally ROC extension has nonnegative energy on this actual positive-definite-covariance field. Strict negative failure yields an independently admissible ROC witness in principle, but none was produced; universal compatibility remains open.
